hypothesis: H12-1: co-located maxima of gravity and magnetic horizontal gradients mark fault-scale contacts without any catalogue information.
mechanism: Faults with both a density contrast (gravity gradient) and a susceptibility contrast (magnetic gradient) at the same location give a product score that is high only where both edges coincide.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic and intrusive contacts, and basin margins, also carry joint gravity and magnetic gradients. The product cannot separate them from faults.
